title: AlienBench: A Benchmark of Structural Novelty in Language Model Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for creative tasks such as writing, design, and idea generation. For these uses, it matters whether a model's ideas depart from familiar examples or stay close to them. Novelty is one standard measure of creativity, and current creativity evaluations ask human experts or LLM judges to rate how novel an output is. However, these ratings have no fixed reference for what counts as novel (or, in other terms, departure from the familiar). Measuring this departure requires a task with known familiar defaults. The structured imagination task from cognitive psychology is such a task. In this creativity test, people imagine a creature from another planet. The departure from features of Earth animals, such as bilateral symmetry and legs as mode of locomotion, is used as measure of creativity. We introduce AlienBench, a benchmark that adapts the structured imagination task to language models. Model

translated_title: AlienBench：语言模型输出中结构性新颖性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于写作、设计和创意生成等创造性任务。对于这些用途而言，模型的创意是偏离熟悉的范例还是贴近它们，这一点非常重要。新颖性是创造力的一项标准衡量指标，目前的创造力评估方法通常请人类专家或大模型评审员来评判输出的新颖程度。然而，这些评分对于什么算作新颖（或者说，对熟悉的偏离）没有固定的参照标准。要测量这种偏离，需要一个具有已知熟悉默认值的任务。认知心理学中的结构化想象任务正是这样一个任务。在这个创造力测试中，人们想象一种来自外星的生物，并以对地球动物特征（如双侧对称性和以腿作为运动方式）的偏离程度作为创造力的衡量标准。我们提出了AlienBench，这是一个将结构化想象任务适配到语言模型的基准测试。模型……
tldr: AlienBench将认知心理学中的结构化想象任务（想象外星生物）适配到语言模型，通过衡量模型输出偏离地球动物熟悉特征（如双侧对称性、腿部运动方式）的程度，为新颖性评估提供了具有固定参照基准的测试方法。
en_tdlr: AlienBench adapts the structured imagination task from cognitive psychology—imagining an alien creature—to provide a fixed-reference benchmark for measuring structural novelty in language model outputs through departure from familiar Earth-animal features.
